notes.title: Did you know you can play That Racecar Game online with friends?
notes.content:
To play That Racecar online, make sure you are connected to the internet when you run the game and then in the steam overlay click "invite friends to play remotely"

You will need to enable their controls for them to play.


If you would like to use a controller, right click That Racecar Game in your steam library and select the controller tab. There will be a dropdown menu, select enable steam input.

You will then be able to plug in a controller and configure the controller controls to your liking.

Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789113/9233e4e3e102a6630409d9f8aa6a3a8eb2443963.png[/img]
